packageRules.description: MinIO AIStor uses non-semver RELEASE.<ISO8601> tags. Map year->major, month->minor, day->patch and the time as build so newer releases sort higher. ⚠ HELD BEHIND DASHBOARD APPROVAL since 2026-10-10: from RELEASE.2026-09-19 the Free tier refuses every write to a bucket with SSE-S3 configured (all our backup buckets) and stores other writes in plaintext (tested with our licence, CLAUDE.md § Object store). Renovate lists new releases on the Dependency Dashboard and opens a PR only when ticked there. pinDigests keeps the @sha256 in sync.

apps/cluster-agent/requirements.lock.txt is GENERATED (`uv export` of apps/cluster-agent/uv.lock) and is what the container installs. Bump the lock (pep621/uv manager), never this file: a direct bump would diverge from the lock. After a lock PR, re-export it (command in apps/cluster-agent/pyproject.toml); apps/cluster-agent/tests/test_requirements_lock.py fails until you do.

`requires-python` is set by hand, never by Renovate. In apps/cluster-agent/pyproject.toml it follows the image's Python minor (the compose `image:` tag), changed in the same PR as `uv lock` + the requirements.lock.txt re-export. At the root it is the laptop floor (`>=3.10`; manage.sh builds its venv with `uv venv --python 3.11`). With `rangeStrategy: bump` Renovate's pep621 manager raised both to `>=3.14.8` in #180, which made the root project unresolvable for that venv on a fresh clone.
